messages:
Megan: Starting Cascade Systems perf POC thread. Ask from sales: validate 2.2k sustained qps on /v1/generate, target p99 < 210ms for short/medium prompts. They care about burst recovery, percent-billed burst minutes, and proof points for KMS/HSM. Tentative window: Fri 10:00 PT, 90m.

Dave: I can own the load harness and runbook. Need exact prompt distribution, streaming ratio, and whether to exercise tokenized path. Also will we run hosted only or attempt Dedicated fallback?

Megan: Prompt mix in sales packet: 68% short (~24 tokens), 27% medium (~140), 5% long (~420). Streaming 15%. Run hosted first; if we hit saturation, spin up a temporary dedicated pool. Auth: API key for hosted; service account for Dedicated. Security Q form due Thu EOD.

Kiran: Ops note: staging currently has 5x A10G but only 3 reserved. I can request 2 more for Fri 08:00-12:00 PT. Private HSM with BYOK import needs ~48h for peering + certs. Hosted envelope KMS is immediate.

Dave: Proposed run plan:
- Ramp: 0 -> 2.2k qps over 12m, hold 40m steady
- Microburst sequence: three 30s spikes to 6.6k qps with 3m recovery intervals
- Cold-session priming: spawn 9k sessions over 10m to observe KV warmup
I'll use vegeta for qps targeting and a small Locust profile for streaming semantics.

Dave: Example vegeta snippet (full bodies in repo):
```
echo "POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" > targets.txt
vegeta attack -rate=2200 -duration=40m -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report -type="hdr"
```
We'll set X-Run-ID and X-Trace headers and include cost meta for token accounting.

Megan: Acceptance criteria suggestion: p99(short+med) <=210ms steady, overall error rate <0.4%, tail recovery <=100s after bursts, and sustained throughput within 5% of target for at least 70% of steady window. Capture p50/p90/p99, errors, GPU occupancy, queue backlog, and token cost.

sec-bot: Expected security asks: KMS/HSM attestation (FIPS level), BYOK import steps, audit log retention, SAML/SCIM SSO notes, SOC2 report link. If Cascade insists on HSM import for Private, ops lead time ~48h.

Kiran: I'll draft short bullets for the security questionnaire and attach a simple network diagram. Requesting capacity now for Fri slot.

ops-bot: Reservation request submitted for +2 A10G on Fri 08:00-12:00 PT. Pending capacity approval.

Dave: Token estimate for pricing note: 2.2k qps * avg 60 tokens/request * 3600s = ~475M tokens/hour. I'll make a clean sheet showing hosted on-demand and a Dedicated commit example reducing unit cost.

Megan: Pricing message: show hosted on-demand estimate, example Dedicated commit that reduces unit cost at scale, and explicit burst-overage billing (per burst-minute). We'll also prepare a short slide explaining graceful degradation options (model-shard fallback, queue shedding).

Dave: Pre-run checklist I'll include in repo: tracing headers set, sampling 100% during run, dashboards for p50/p90/p99, qps, errors, GPU util, kernel logs enabled. I'll push runbook + scripts to perf/cascade and drop link.

Kiran: Capacity approved for +2 A10G. I'll enable kernel tracing and pass GPU occupancy metrics to the dashboard. If we see saturation, we'll flip to fallback model variant.

Megan: Please react with :white_check_mark: when tasks are done. We'll post pre-run checklist 24h before and use this thread for run artifacts & final writeup.

Dave: :white_check_mark: run scripts drafted and payload mix validated locally. Pushing to repo shortly.

Kiran: :white_check_mark: capacity live and security bullets drafted.

sec-bot: :white_check_mark: security draft posted to doc; added expected turnaround for HSM/BYOK.

Megan: Thanks all  we'll collate and share the results writeup after the run.
